mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM offering_members WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} AND role='student' AND status='active' ORDER BY user_id

SELECT student_id,knowledge_point_id,assignment_id,result,occurred_at,id FROM knowledge_evidence WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} AND is_current=1 ORDER BY student_id,knowledge_point_id,occurred_at DESC,id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT w.student_id,ak.knowledge_point_id FROM assignments a JOIN assignment_knowledge_points ak ON ak.assignment_id=a.id JOIN workspaces w ON w.assignment_id=a.id JOIN course_offerings o ON o.id=a.offering_id WHERE a.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND a.status='published' AND o.status='active' AND a.published_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM submissions s WHERE s.assignment_id=a.id AND s.student_id=w.student_id AND s.is_current=1)
